claims.claim_text: item-01 寫入約 4 萬筆 JSON 要跑好幾分鐘、吃滿一顆核心
claims.evidence: Inserting about 40,000 JSON records took minutes; "completely saturated a core, being a CPU-bound operation."

claims.claim_text: item-01 strspn 一開始就量完整個字串，成本隨檔案大小呈平方成長
claims.evidence: "the first step measures the entire length of the string." "As the file gets larger, the slowdown is quadratic."

claims.claim_text: item-01 1.2MB 檔案慢約 12,000 倍
claims.evidence: "approximately 12,000x slower with this pattern" (1.2MB file)

claims.claim_text: item-01 作者預先清掉空白並把 Linux 建置搬進容器
claims.evidence: "original fix ... was to pre-prune whitespace from JSON." "I moved my Linux builds over to Linux containers."

claims.claim_text: item-02 過去任何變更都觸發整個 zone 重建，含 Universal SSL
claims.evidence: "A full build only needed to know that the zone changed." Zone setting changes "used to rebuild entire DNS zones"

claims.claim_text: item-02 planner 分五種建置，挑能證明正確的最小一種，統一排程器合併
claims.evidence: "the planner can choose one of five build types"; "We replaced them with one unified scheduler."

claims.claim_text: item-02 完整建置減約 40%、尖峰記憶體 79→12 GiB、中位延遲約 7.7→3.3 秒
claims.evidence: "full builds fell by about 40%." "Peaks fell from 79 GiB to 12 GiB, an 85% reduction." "from about 7.7 seconds to about 3.3 seconds."

claims.claim_text: item-03 encoding/json/v2 與 jsontext 在 Go 1.27 穩定可用
claims.evidence: "the new encoding/json/v2 and encoding/json/jsontext packages are stable and generally available in Go 1.27!"

claims.claim_text: item-03 v2 預設對無效 UTF-8 與重複鍵報錯、nil 輸出 []/{}、名稱區分大小寫
claims.evidence: v2 rejects invalid UTF-8 and duplicate object names; marshals nil slices/maps as empty JSON arrays/objects; matches case-sensitively (fetch summary)

claims.claim_text: item-03 marshal 與 v1 相近、unmarshal 最多快 10 倍
claims.evidence: Marshal roughly on par with v1; "Benchmarks show up to 10x speedups"

claims.claim_text: item-03 v1 受 Go 1 相容性承諾保護，底層建在 v2 上
claims.evidence: v1 remains covered by the Go 1 compatibility promise; v1 is implemented on top of v2.

claims.claim_text: item-04 Flink 每個 Kafka partition 為一個 split，checkpoint 完成後才提交 offset
claims.evidence: "Typically, the Kafka source reader commits the checkpointed offsets to Kafka once a checkpoint has completed."

claims.claim_text: item-04 舊行為 offset 設為最後一筆加 1，遇交易標記使 lag 顯示 1（FLINK-33484）
claims.evidence: "the reported lag according to Kafka was stuck at 1, not 0."

claims.claim_text: item-04 提交盡力而為；lag 可能過時；stop-with-savepoint 可能跳過排隊提交
claims.evidence: "The committed offset is a side channel." "the fetcher shuts down without running the queued task"

claims.claim_text: item-05 musl crypt() 對超過 256 位元組密碼回傳 * 當錯誤標記
claims.evidence: "musl’s crypt() returns the string * as an error indicator when the key is over 256 bytes long."

claims.claim_text: item-05 攻擊需密碼欄為 * 的帳號並送 257–1024 位元組密碼
claims.evidence: "The machine has an account whose password field is *." "The attacker then sends a very long password (257 to 1024 bytes)."
"Alpine 3.21.10, 3.22.8, 3.23.8 and 3.24.4 contain the fixed package." "Restart sshd after upgrading."

claims.claim_text: item-05 公告寫明尚無 CVE 編號
claims.evidence: "No CVE identifier had been assigned at the time of writing."

claims.claim_text: item-06 2B 像素空間 DiT、無 VAE、32×32 patch、凍結 Qwen3.5-4B
claims.evidence: "2B-parameter DiT, 4B text encoder"; "32×32 patches"; "a frozen Qwen3.5-4B model"

claims.claim_text: item-06 約 8,415 H100 小時、21,038 美元、Apache 2.0
item-06 沒有標準 benchmark 分數、寫不出文字、不擅長多人互動與全身人像（原稿誤稱『作者自己承認』）
claims.evidence: "cannot write text or generate posters"; struggles with "multi-person interactions" and "full body". Page shows no GenEval/DPG/FID.
claims.note: Lede now plain observation, not attributed admission.

claims.claim_text: item-07 每行 flush 是 unzip 處理大量小檔案的瓶頸，glibc 對各行各發 write
claims.evidence: "This printout dominates extraction time of archives with many small files."

claims.claim_text: item-07 加 deadline、處理單元間檢查、約 100 毫秒、不需額外執行緒
claims.evidence: "flush the buffer if it's been idle a short time"; deadline around 100 ms

claims.claim_text: item-07 文章沒有給 benchmark 數字
claims.evidence: Source gives no benchmark numbers.

claims.claim_text: item-08 span 壓縮讓增量建置只 intern 約 1%（原 20-40%）
claims.evidence: "we now typically intern around 1% of spans compared to 20-40% with the old scheme."

claims.claim_text: item-08 新 trait solver 在 Diesel Check Full 開銷 1.49→1.16 倍
claims.evidence: Instruction count overhead on Diesel Check Full went from 1.49x to 1.16x. (fetch summary)

claims.claim_text: item-08 236 項改善、4 項退步；wall-time 降 2.85%、max-RSS 降 4.46%
claims.evidence: "improvements on 236 tests across 45 benchmarks"; "mean wall-time reduction of 2.85%"; "mean max-RSS (peak memory) reduction of 4.46%"

claims.claim_text: item-08 跳過 trivial const MIR 仍為草稿，後續方向不明
claims.evidence: "the path forward here is unclear"

claims.claim_text: item-09 Safari 27.3 beta Adaptive Dark Mode 保留色相翻轉亮度、文字符合 WCAG 4.5:1
claims.evidence: "Adaptive Dark Mode in Safari 27.3 beta." "WCAG 4.5:1 contrast ratio."

claims.claim_text: item-09 已宣告 light dark 的網站不受影響；beta 1 不支援 only 關鍵字
claims.evidence: "Adaptive Dark Mode does not change a thing." "the 'only' keyword is not supported in Safari 27.3 beta 1."

claims.claim_text: item-09 點陣圖多半不動，canvas 不動
claims.evidence: "Most are left unchanged"; "<canvas> content is left unchanged"

claims.claim_text: item-10 比較 Tachyon、py-spy、Scalene、Austin，皆為取樣型
claims.evidence: "All four tools in this post are sampling profilers".

claims.claim_text: item-10 研究：取樣 profiler CPU 模式額外成本 0-2%，cProfile 73%
claims.evidence: "adding between 0% and 2% to the run time, compared with 73% for cProfile"

claims.claim_text: item-10 建議 3.15 用 Tachyon、記憶體/GPU 用 Scalene、舊版或線上用 py-spy/Austin
claims.evidence: On 3.15 "start with Tachyon"; line-level memory or GPU time: Scalene; older Python or attaching to production: py-spy or Austin.

claims.claim_text: item-10 作者維護 Austin
claims.evidence: Author maintains Austin, "for the best part of eight years now".
